# Trading News Terminal

> Professional real-time financial news terminal for active traders. Live market-moving news (forex, crypto, stocks, commodities, macro), economic calendar, squawk box, central banks tracker and TradingView charts in one zero-clutter interface. Basic is free forever; Pro is €40/month.

Trading News Terminal (TNT) delivers institutional-grade market news the moment it crosses the wire, plus the tools traders use to act on it. It is built for active forex, futures, crypto and macro traders who need speed and signal over noise. Founded by Luís Barata, a forex and macro trader with 13+ years in the markets.

## What it is
- Real-time financial news feed - zero delay on Pro; ~5-minute delay on the free Basic plan.
- HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW impact classification so traders see what actually moves markets.
- Coverage across forex, indices, stocks, commodities, crypto, bonds and macro.

## Core features
- Live economic calendar (NFP, CPI, FOMC, ECB, GDP, PMI) with countdown timers and beat/miss signals.
- Squawk Box - live audio alerts of breaking headlines.
- Central Banks Tracker (Fed, ECB, BOE, BOJ, SNB, BOC, RBA, RBNZ).
- Earnings calendar, Market Screener, Market Sentiment (risk-on/risk-off), Macro & Bonds Hub.
- 7 live financial TV channels.
- Telegram alerts + custom keyword alerts.
- AI-assisted market analysis.

## Pricing
- Basic: Free forever, no credit card. News feed with a ~5-minute delay.
- Pro: €40/month, or €360/year (3 months free vs monthly). 7-day free trial, cancel anytime. Removes the news delay and unlocks Squawk, 7 live TV channels, Market Screener, Central Banks Tracker, Market Sentiment and the Macro & Bonds Hub.
- Telegram Premium: €19/month - unlimited real-time HIGH-impact alerts, ad-free.
